```{r}
#| label: setup

library(gifski)
library(tidyverse)

n_images <- 9000
step_size <- 0.2
```

## circle2

The circleFun function is found at Stack Overflow

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/6862742/draw-a-circle-with-ggplot2

Also see 

https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/geom_tile.html

https://www.jstor.org/stable/24976032


```{r}
#| fig.width: 7
#| fig.height: 7
#| eval: true

circle_files <- sprintf("../images/circle%04d.png", 1:n_images)

draw_circles <- function(w, k) {
  x <- rep(-100:100, 201) / 100
  y <- rep(-100:100, each=201) / 100
  r <- x^2 + y^2
  z <- (r*w) %% 2 + 1
  n_circles <- ceiling(max(r*w)/2-0.2)
  # max(floor(r*w)) %/% 2

  z <- c("black", "white")[z]

  data.frame(x, y, z) |>
    ggplot() +
    aes(x=x, y=y) +
    geom_raster(fill=z) +
    # labs(title=n_circles) +
    # geom_label(x=0, y=0, label=n) +
    theme_void() -> p
  
  file_name <- paste0(
    "../images/circle", 
    str_pad(k, width=4, pad="0"),
    ".png")
  file_name <- sprintf("../images/circle%04d.png", k)
  ggsave(circle_files[k], width=201, height=201, unit="px")
}

for (k in 1:n_images) {
  w <- 1 + (k-1)*step_size
  draw_circles(w, k)
  cat(k)
  cat(" ")
}

gif_file <- "circle_animation.gif"
gifski(
  circle_files, 
  gif_file,
  delay=0.03,
  loop=FALSE)
```
